reason: Actual OpenSpec 1.12.0 specs instructions require Purpose for new capabilities. The reviewed draft omitted this non-normative summary.
adjustment: Prefix the same approved purpose; no Requirement, Scenario, implementation design, task or acceptance change.
prefix:
## Purpose

This capability verifies that an approved menu design is consumed by a native Cocos Android application, preserving its menu, dialog, session, lifecycle, resources and delivery behavior on the two selected simulators.
